review_comments.body: 💡 Edge Case: NaN/Inf sampling values produce an invalid JSON request body `parseSampling` uses `strconv.ParseFloat`, which accepts `nan`, `inf`, and `infinity` without an error. So `--temperature nan` or `TGPT_TOP_P=inf` returns a non-nil pointer, and `strconv.FormatFloat` turns it into `NaN` or `+Inf`. The value is put into the hand-built body with `%v`, so the request is sent as malformed JSON (`"temperature": NaN`). Before this change the body was always valid JSON. The fix is to skip non-finite values so the 0.5 default stays, or to build the body with `json.Marshal` so the bad value is caught. **Only override the default with finite values:** ```` t, p := params.SamplingOptions() if t != nil && !math.IsNaN(*t) && !math.IsInf(*t, 0) { temperature = strconv.FormatFloat(*t, 'f', -1, 64) } if p != nil && !math.IsNaN(*p) && !math.IsInf(*p, 0) { top_p = strconv.FormatFloat(*p, 'f', -1, 64) } ```` Was this helpful?
